projects.title: Artella Residential Development
projects.summary: A residential and shophouse development comprising two towers of approximately 30 stories and 1,700 units.
projects.body: The development brings together high-rise housing and shophouse uses in Di An, Binh Duong. Its scale comprises approximately 1,700 residential units across two towers of around 30 stories, with site coverage of approximately 35%.

projects.title: Khanh Hoi Port Redevelopment
projects.summary: Concept development for a large-scale urban redevelopment, with design and performance studies and coordination with city and district-level authorities on transport, water systems and planning requirements.
projects.body: The work combines concept design and performance studies with coordination on urban infrastructure. Discussions with city and district-level authorities addressed transport connections, water systems and planning requirements for the approximately 450,000 m² site.

projects.title: Grand Marina Saigon
projects.summary: Architectural design development for a luxury residential project comprising four towers of 40 stories each. Work included coordination with international consultants across facade, interior, structure and MEP disciplines.
facts: Concept, schematic design and design development
projects.body: The architectural scope spans concept design, schematic design and design development. Coordination with international consultants brought together facade, interior, structural and MEP disciplines across four 40-story residential towers.

projects.title: Vung Tau City Master Plan Proposal
projects.summary: A city-scale master planning proposal connecting the planning vision with infrastructure and environmental systems, supported by design, technology and performance analysis.
projects.body: The proposal is presented as a city-scale planning study for the Vung Tau People’s Committee. The role connects design technology and performance analysis with the development of the planning concept and proposal.

projects.title: Saigon Peninsula
projects.summary: Feasibility and concept studies for a mixed-use development of approximately 1.02 km², including high-rise buildings, villas, shophouses and commercial uses.
projects.body: Building performance analysis supports feasibility and concept studies for a mixed-use site in District 7. The approximately 1.02 km² development brings together high-rise buildings, villas, shophouses and commercial uses, with a stated FAR of 4.0.

intro: Architect and project manager working across high-rise residential developments and city-scale master planning, with a focus on design coordination, data and BIM.
bio: Architect and project leader specializing in high-rise and large-scale urban developments. Experience spans concept design, design development and coordination with multidisciplinary teams and authorities.
Research and teaching at the Institute of Smart City Management, UEH, explore data-driven architectural design, BIM and computational methods applied to urban development.
